summary: Big four gimmes, then a tense guessing game among European countries where every miss is a near miss. Casual got 9 and lost on the last life, which is exactly the right feel.
reasons: Good curve: US, UK, Germany and France are free, Sweden, Japan, Russia and Canada take thought, Austria is the fair stretch
Misses teach something: Netherlands #11, Italy #12, Israel #16, Norway #18 (despite the Peace Prize), China only #31
Every country a casual typed in Blitz scored (29/29); usa, uk, england, britain and ussr all match
fixes: Drop junk aliases on Sweden (#6): 'Swedish sin', 'Folkland'
'west germany' is not recognized; add it as a Germany alias for this list (several laureates are listed under West Germany)
